selection: picked: JasperBlank's 48 poles (#1018-#1021), Codex pilot round 3

neighbours.label: Describes an event or interval as brief, or as taking less time.
fire: During the emergency drill, the revised procedure shortened the evacuation time while keeping every safety check in place.
The manager kept the meeting short so everyone could return to work before lunch.
With the faster connection, the download took only a few seconds instead of several minutes.
After the treatment, the fever lasted fewer days, allowing patients to resume their usual activities sooner.
By processing applications automatically, the agency cut the waiting period from several weeks to a single day.
At the microphone, each speaker was asked to give a brief introduction before the discussion began.
Following the timetable change, commuters enjoyed a much shorter journey despite traveling between the same two stations.
During the experiment, only a moment separated the warning light from the release of the falling weight.
quiet: Under the updated emergency plan, the evacuation took longer because staff inspected each room before leaving the building.
Before the meeting, the manager placed a short pencil beside every notepad around the conference table.
On the unreliable connection, the download continued for several minutes while the progress indicator advanced at a steady pace.
Among the treated patients, the fever became milder while its duration remained similar to that observed in the comparison group.
Because applications required additional manual checks, the agency extended the waiting period from several weeks to three months.
At the podium, each speaker delivered a lengthy introduction before the discussion finally began.
Along the commuter route, a short fence separated the station platform from the adjacent parking lot.
In the laboratory, a prolonged interval separated the warning light from the release of the falling weight.
